travelSpeaking.label: 旅行開口
travelSpeaking.goal: 能在旅行或外出時開口問、確認、回應。

publicEnglish.label: 公共英文
publicEnglish.goal: 能看懂車站、商店、交通與公共場所的簡短英文提示。

onlineReading.label: 英文資訊判讀
onlineReading.goal: 能看懂手機、網頁、app、搜尋結果或貼文中的關鍵英文資訊。

dailyResponse.label: 日常反應
dailyResponse.goal: 能用短句處理不確定、選擇、等待、求助與確認。

sessions.title: Requesting a Late Checkout Before a Late Flight
evidence: Mission: read hotel checkout rules, request a later checkout, and switch to luggage storage when the hotel is full.
Input: hotel app notice and front-desk conversation.
Find regular checkout at eleven, the nine a.m. request deadline, the twenty-dollar charge, and free luggage storage until six.
Say "Can I extend my checkout until noon?" / "Can I pick up my luggage at five thirty?"; ask for repetition when late checkout is not available.

sessions.title: Checking a Wrong Price at an Airport Gift Shop
evidence: Mission: read an airport gift-shop offer, verify a wrong price, and confirm the final amount before paying.
Input: airport shop page, in-store offer sign, price tag, and cashier conversation.
Find local gifts on sale until eight p.m., a twenty percent discount, prices including tax, and a thirty-day exchange condition.
Say "Could you check this price?" / "Is that the final amount?"; ask for repetition when the offer or amount changes.

sessions.title: Ordering a Safe Café Meal with a Food Allergy
evidence: Mission: read a café menu, check dairy information, and complete a safe order after the first dish sells out.
Input: phone menu, allergy notice, and ordering conversation.
Find the fourteen-dollar chicken bowl, dairy-free information, rice and vegetables, sold out, and the thirteen-dollar tofu bowl before tax.
Say "Is this dish dairy-free?" / "What does it come with?" / "Is there another option?"; ask for repetition when the new dish name is unclear.

sessions.title: Taking the Right City Bus During a Road Detour
evidence: Mission: read a bus detour notice, find the temporary stop, and reach the city museum.
Input: map result, bus detour notice, and driver conversation.
Find Bus Twelve, the temporary stop opposite the bookstore, Museum Square, and three stops.
Say "Which bus goes to the museum?" / "Where should I get off?"; confirm the route after the road-work change.

sessions.title: Finding the Hotel After a Station Exit Change
evidence: Mission: find the hotel after Exit Three closes and the route changes to Exit Five.
Input: station notice, map result, and information-desk conversation.
Find Exit Three closed, Exit Five, the eight-minute walk, the blue signs, and the side entrance.
Say "Which exit should I use?" / "Could you show me the way?"; follow the route and cross at the traffic light.

sessions.title: Finding the Right Airport Train After a Platform Change
evidence: Mission: find the Airport Express platform and handle a platform change.
Input: departure screen, station notice, and staff conversation.
Find Airport Express, 6:30, Platform Four, the twenty-minute delay, and Platform Six.
Say "Which platform does it leave from?" / "When does it depart?"; confirm the day pass works for the replacement train.

sessions.title: Returning a Rental Car with a Full Tank
evidence: Mission: read a rental confirmation and return notice, then complete a car return after Lot B fills.
Input: rental confirmation, fuel policy, parking notice, and rental-desk conversations.
Find the 8 p.m. deadline, full-tank rule, Lot B, the Lot C change, and the printed-receipt step.
Say "Where do I return the car?" / "Does the tank need to be full?"; describe damage, take clear photos, and confirm the deposit return.

sessions.title: Getting an Airport Tax Refund
evidence: Mission: read airport tax-refund instructions and complete the refund after a counter move.
Input: tax refund guide, airport notice, customs conversation, and refund-counter conversation.
Find the $100 minimum purchase, Customs Desk B before security, Level Three, and the Gate Twelve update.
Say "Where can I get a tax refund?" / "Do I need the original receipt?"; ask for a cash option when card refunds take five days.

sessions.title: Finding the Walking Tour Meeting Point
evidence: Mission: read a walking-tour confirmation and find the meeting point after a rain change.
Input: confirmation email, map result, rain update, and guide conversation.
Find the 9:30 start, City Hall fountain, fifteen-minute early-arrival rule, and yellow umbrella.
Say "Is this the meeting point?" / "How can I find the guide?"; move to the museum entrance at 9:20 after the update.

sessions.title: Checking Carry-on Liquid Rules Before Security
evidence: Mission: read carry-on liquid rules and handle an oversized bottle before airport security.
Input: airport website rules, security sign, and airport screening conversation.
Find the 100 ml container limit, one clear one-liter bag rule, and the instruction to remove the bag.
Say "Can I take this through security?" / "Is it one hundred milliliters or less?" / "Do I need to take it out?"

sessions.title: Reporting a Missing Suitcase at Baggage Claim
evidence: Mission: report a missing suitcase and confirm the delivery plan.
Input: baggage claim screen, help-desk notice, and airport service conversation.
Find carousel six, carousel eight for oversized bags, and the 11:30 p.m. desk closing time.
Say "My suitcase is missing." / "Where is the baggage claim desk?" / "Could you help me find it?"

sessions.title: Fixing a Noisy Hotel Air Conditioner
evidence: Mission: read a hotel maintenance notice and report a noisy air conditioner that does not cool the room.
Input: hotel room help card, maintenance notice, and front-desk conversation.
Find quiet hours, the 10 p.m. desk closing time, and dial zero for urgent repairs; then change to room 314 when the repair needs a new part.
Say "The air conditioner isn’t working." / "Is the maintenance desk still open?" / "Can I change rooms?"

sessions.title: Buying Sunscreen for a Beach Day
evidence: Mission: read sunscreen labels and buy a travel-size product for a beach day.
Input: pharmacy shelf sign, product labels, and a short store conversation.
Find SPF 30 / $12, SPF 50 / $18, water-resistance times, and the two-hour reapplication rule; then choose a $10 SPF 50 stick when the small bottle is sold out.
Say "How often should I reapply it?" / "Is this okay for sensitive skin?" / "Do you have a smaller bottle?"

sessions.title: Choosing a Safe Hotel Breakfast
evidence: Mission: read hotel breakfast information and order safely with a nut allergy.
Input: hotel breakfast menu, allergy warning, and cafe conversation.
Find the 7:00–10:00 hours, $12 adult price, and free-refill rule; then choose nut-free oatmeal when eggs are unavailable.
Say "Does this contain nuts?" / "What can I have instead?" / "Does coffee have free refills?"

sessions.title: Taking a Harbor Ferry After a Pier Change
evidence: Mission: take a harbor ferry and find the new pier after a change.
Input: ferry board, change notice, and ticket-window conversation.
Find the 10:20 departure, Pier Three, the $12 round-trip ticket, and the 5:00 last return; then move to Pier Five after a ten-minute delay.
Say "Which pier does it leave from?" / "Could you show me on the map?" / "I'd like one round-trip ticket, please."

sessions.title: Using a City Bus Day Pass
evidence: Mission: buy a city bus day pass and get off at the correct stop.
Input: bus-stop sign and short driver conversation.
Find Bus 8, the fifteen-minute interval, the $6 day pass, and the midnight end time; then use the City Library when the market stop is closed.
Say "Does this bus go to Central Market?" / "Could you say that again?" / "Please tell me when we get to the library."

sessions.title: Mailing a Postcard from Abroad
evidence: Mission: read international postage information and mail a postcard from abroad.
Input: international postage sign, machine notice, and post-office conversation.
Find the $2 / $3.50 postcard rates, the 7–10-business-day delivery time, and Counter Four; then handle an out-of-service machine and an oversized postcard.
Say "How much postage do I need?" / "How long will it take?" / "Could you write it down for me?"

sessions.title: Using a Timed Ticket at the Museum
evidence: Mission: read museum entry rules and handle a missed admission time.
Input: museum ticket page, entry rules, and entrance conversation.
Find the weekend timed-admission rule, the 2:30 slot, and the large-bag locker rule; then move to 3:30.
Say "Am I allowed to bring this bag inside?" / "Could you say it more slowly?" / "Is there another time available?"

sessions.title: Buying Mobile Data at the Airport
evidence: Mission: compare, buy, and activate a seven-day mobile data plan at the airport.
Input: mobile plan sign and phone-shop conversation.
Find the 10 GB / $18 plan, the unlimited / $25 plan, and the free-setup condition.
Say "How much is it altogether?" / "Could you check it?" / "What should I do if it stops working?"

sessions.title: Choosing an Airport Ride After a Stop Change
evidence: Mission: compare airport transport and handle a changed shuttle stop.
Input: airport transport page, information-desk dialogue, and service update.
Find the $12 / 35-minute / Terminal 1 B1 train and the $8 / 50-minute / Stop 6 shuttle, then update to Stop 8 near Door 4.
Say "How long does it take?" / "Where does it leave from?" / "Could you say that again?"

sessions.title: Handling a Stuck Hotel Laundry Machine
evidence: Mission: handle a stuck hotel laundry machine.
Input: hotel laundry notice and front-desk dialogue.
Find Laundry Room B on Floor 2, the 7 a.m.–10 p.m. hours, the do-not-pull rule, and the thirty-minute repair time.
Say "The washer is stuck." / "Is it working?" / "Could you call for a repair?"

sessions.title: Fixing a Missing Café Item
evidence: Mission: fix a missing item in a café takeaway order.
Input: café pickup notice and counter dialogue.
Find Counter 2, the ten-minute remake time, and the replacement/refund option.
Say "I need to report a missing item." / "Could you remake it?" / "I can show the receipt."

sessions.title: Fixing a Hotel Key Card Problem
evidence: Mission: fix a hotel key-card problem and regain room access.
Input: hotel notice and front-desk dialogue.
Find the blocked/expired-card rule, ID + free reset, desk hours, and the new-room option.
Say "My card does not work. Could you reset the card?" / "I can show my ID." / "What is another option?"

sessions.title: Changing a Train Ticket After a Delay
evidence: Mission: read a rail-app delay notice and change the train plan.
Input: delay notice and ticket-counter dialogue.
Find the 20-minute delay, ticket validity, no change fee, and Platform 3.
Say "Is this ticket still valid?" / "Could you say that again?" / "I will take a later train."

sessions.title: Reporting a Damaged Suitcase
evidence: Mission: report damaged baggage and complete the repair form.
Input: airport baggage-service notice and counter dialogue.
Find the photo instruction, baggage-tag instruction, and Desk 5 destination.
Say "I need to report damaged baggage." / "Could you say that again?" / "Should I bring the form there?"

sessions.title: Fixing a Broken Rental Bike
evidence: Mission: report a broken rental-bike lock and get a replacement.
Input: bike-rental app notice and help-desk dialogue.
Find Bike 18's problem, the replacement-bike station, the scan instruction, and the 10 p.m. return time.
Say "The lock is broken. Can you help me?" / "Could you say that again?" / "Please scan the code before you ride."

sessions.title: Checking a Store Return Policy
evidence: Mission: read a store return policy and exchange a shirt size.
Input: online return policy and shop-counter dialogue.
Find the thirty-day window, receipt and label requirements, and the sale-item restriction.
Could I exchange this for a larger size? / The larger size is out of stock. / Sorry, did you say refund or store credit?

sessions.title: Reading a Café Menu and Ordering Lunch
evidence: Mission: read an online café menu and complete a lunch order.
Input: café menu and counter dialogue.
Find the NT$180 price, service time until 2:00, included drink, and 12:20 pickup time.
I need to check the menu first. / Could I get the lunch set, please? / Sorry, did you say 12:20 or 12:30?

sessions.title: Checking Hotel Breakfast and Luggage
evidence: Mission: read hotel guest information and ask about luggage storage after checkout.
Input: hotel information page and reception dialogue.
Find breakfast time, Floor 2, the 11:00 checkout time, and luggage storage at reception.
Can I leave my luggage here after checkout? / Did you say five or six? / I want to make sure breakfast is included.

sessions.title: Reading a Train Service Notice
evidence: Mission: read a train service alert and confirm the replacement bus location.
Input: train service notice, station sign, and staff dialogue.
Find the affected Blue Line, the cancelled 8:30 train, Platform 4, and the updated Stop C location.
Does the replacement bus go to Central Station? / I didn't catch that. / Where should I go now?

sessions.title: Finding the Right Station Exit
evidence: Mission: follow a station map and confirm the right exit for the City Library.
Input: station map, Exit 4 notice, and an information-desk dialogue.
Find the Green Line, Platform 2, Exit 4, and the 10 p.m. closing time.
Which way should I go for Exit 4? / I didn't catch that. / Where should I go now?

sessions.title: Choosing a Ferry Departure
evidence: Mission: read a ferry timetable and choose a boat when the first one is sold out.
Input: ferry timetable, ticket notice, and a counter dialogue.
The first boat leaves from Dock 2 at 9:20; boarding starts at 9:55.
Is the 10:10 boat still available? / Where should I go now?
